accountUpgradeBody1: You're currently on an anonymous account. Your data syncs to Supabase cloud — but if you clear browser data or your session resets, you lose access to it.
accountUpgradeBody2: Linking a Google account keeps your current UID and all your data. Zero risk of losing progress; sign in from any device.
accountSignInGoogleFresh: Sign in with a different Google account
accountUpgradeNote: Anonymous → Google upgrade preserves your UID. Signing in fresh discards this device's data.
accountSignOutWarn: After signing out, reopening the site creates a new anonymous account. Sign in with Google again to return to your previous data.
accountSwitchWarn: Current session will end and you'll sign in with a different Google account.
accountRegisterErrorAlreadyExists: This Google account is already registered. Use "Sign In" instead.
syncConflictBody: Your data on this device differs from your cloud account. Which version would you like to keep?
syncConflictNote: Missing entries are merged after picking; nothing is permanently deleted.

pageHelpFootnote: Tip: Press Ctrl+K (⌘K on Mac) to open the command palette anywhere.

Add items via the Add button or search drawer

Drag-and-drop to reorder, click an item to see donate details

Add craft item — opens the search drawer

Share — copy/paste a build link

Ctrl/⌘ K — command palette

helpRelicTips:
Relics auto-sync with your craft list — items you add appear here
Mark components as found to track refinement-level progress
Use Open/Done filters to focus the list
helpRelicActions:
Click a card — view full drop tables
Refine selector — switch between Intact/Exceptional/Flawless/Radiant
helpInventoryTips:
Add prime parts you own — sets are built automatically
The Sets tab shows complete builds and craftable totals
Click the platinum icon to open Warframe Market for the part

Add part — opens the search drawer

helpMasteryTips:
Click a card to cycle: Owned → Mastered → Empty

Multi-select for bulk operations across categories

Multi-select toggle — enables checkboxes
Bulk Mark Owned/Mastered/Clear — apply to all selected
Category pills — focus on Warframes, Primary, etc.

Right-click — clear status
Ctrl/⌘ K — command palette
helpTimersTips:
Cycles update live — Cetus day/night, Vallis warm/cold, Cambion Fass/Vome

Tracker — record progress on parts you're farming

Live data refreshes every 60 seconds
Fissure rotation, Sortie/Archon Hunt, Arbitration shown live

profileImportSubtitle: Sync your real Mastery Rank and item list from Warframe.
profileImportIdHelpBody: Open Warframe, then close it. On Windows, press Win+R and run %localappdata%\\Warframe — open EE.log in Notepad and search for 'Logged in (' — the 24-character hex inside parentheses is your Player ID. On Steam Deck/Linux it's under your Proton compat data folder.
profileImportFileHelp: Open https://content.warframe.com/dynamic/getProfileViewingData.php?playerId=YOUR_ID in your browser, save the page as profile.json, then upload it here.
profileImportConfirmHint: This replaces existing mastery state with the imported one. Your other tracker data (craft, relic, inventory) is unaffected.
mrCalcSourceEstimateDesc: This calculation only counts items you've manually marked. For exact MR, click 'Import from Game' on the Mastery page.
masteryClearAllContent: This will reset {count} items back to unmarked. Profile import data (MR, total XP) is kept. You can undo within 5 seconds.
masterySyncHelp: Auto-refresh every 5 min while this page is visible. Disconnect to stop.
hintMasterySyncClick: In Sync mode, clicking an item adds it to your Craft Tracker. Master state is read live from your profile.
